title: BlackRoad OS Window
description: Manifest entry for one OS window/app. Registry/windows.json is the single source of truth; the WINDOW_REGISTRY const in index.html (and the ACTION_TO_ROUTE / CLOSE_BY_WIN_ID maps derived from it) are generated by scripts/sync-windows.mjs.

kind.description: system = core OS page; app = product window.

elementId.description: DOM id of the window root element.

openFn.description: Global function that opens the window.

closeFn.description: Global function that closes the window.
